dialog.onboardingTitle: Help your AI teacher understand you
dialog.profileLabel: Introduce yourself in a few sentences
dialog.profilePlaceholder: Example: You can call me Alex. I live in Shanghai and studied business administration at university. Since graduating, I have had a regular office job, mostly organizing documents, writing emails, and making spreadsheets. I do not have a technical background and have limited time after work, but I have always wanted to build something of my own. Recently, I hope to use AI to organize my ideas and fill gaps in my knowledge, turning my observations about city life and work into useful articles and small tools, and gradually developing a personal project I can pursue for years. New terminology and complicated steps can easily overwhelm me, so I would like my AI teacher to first explain how a topic relates to this goal, then teach it step by step in plain language with examples from office and everyday life, and compare the effort and results of different options. Please use a friendly, direct tone that is not too formal.
